title: Try
description: Try a list of wrangles and catch any errors that occur.

recipe_writer.reason: Error-control orchestration is not supported in the baseline.

configuration_schema.description: Try a list of wrangles and catch any errors that occur

except.description:
An action to take if the wrangles encounter an error.
This can contain a list of wrangles or a dictionary of column names and values.
If except is not provided, the error will be logged and the recipe will continue.

retries.description: Number of times to retry the wrangles if an error occurs. Default 0.

guidance:
Run a list of wrangles and catch errors. When `except` is provided, its wrangles or fallback column values run after an error; otherwise, the error is logged and the recipe continues. The runtime supports both forms, but the pinned upstream schema only permits a dictionary for `except`. Use fallback column values for schema-validated recipes. ## Migrated examples #### Use Fallback Column Values After an Error ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - try: wrangles: - convert.data_type: input: column data_type: int except: column: unavailable ```
##### Input Sample _The input dataframe is passed to the primary wrangles._
##### Output Sample _The primary result is returned on success; the `except` result is returned after an error._
